public-sans.$description: The universal UI and editorial face: 16px/400 body text, 14px/500 navigation, 14px/600 section labels, 16px/500 buttons, and 48px or 72px/700 displays. The -0.025em tracking at 48px and 72px compresses the heavy display weight into framework-tool directness rather than oversized marketing softness.
